name: sdg07
title: SDG 7: Affordable and clean energy (SDG Atlas of Bolivia 2026)
description: The SDG 7 (Affordable and clean energy) index of the Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026 (SDSN Bolivia) and the 4 indicators behind it, for Bolivia's 343 municipalities and indigenous autonomies (GAIOC), at two points in time: near the 2012 census and near the 2024 census, stored as 2012 and 2024 so that their change can be studied.

geo:notes: Both periods are stored at nominal years: 2012 for the Atlas's initial values (~2012) and 2024 for its final values (~2024). Each indicator's actual reference years differ (e.g. 2008 and 2023 for the health survey, three-year averages for volatile indicators) and are given in its description and in `geo:reference_years`.
Load one variable in both periods, e.g. `geo.load("sdg07", variables="index_sdg7", names=True)`, and its change per unit with `geo.change(df, "index_sdg7")`.

The units are the 343 municipalities and indigenous autonomies (GAIOC) of 2025. Four of them were created after the 2012 census (TIOC-Raqaypampa, San Pedro de Macha, TIOC-Jatun Ayllu Yura and TIOC-Territorio Indígena Multiétnico); the Atlas gives them values in both periods.

Aggregating to provinces, departments or Bolivia (`geo.aggregate`, `geo.combine`) averages the municipal values weighted by census population (`weighted_mean:population`; the 2012 census for ~2012 and the 2024 census for ~2024, loaded from the `sdg` dataset through `geo:weights`): e.g. `geo.aggregate(geo.load("sdg07"), to="department", dataset="sdg07")`. These are population-weighted approximations, not the Atlas's own department figures.

fields.name: geo_id
fields.title: Municipality ID
fields.description: GDO-Bolivia municipality geo ID (BO-DD-PP-MM) of the 343-unit municipality map (SDSN Bolivia 2025: municipalities and indigenous autonomies), numbered as in GADM 4.1 plus four units created since; map343; its boundary is in geo/boundaries/map343. It nests by prefix into the department (BO-DD) and province (BO-DD-PP) IDs; department and province numbers follow GADM order and differ from INE codes.

fields.name: year
fields.title: Period
fields.description: Period of the values in the row: 2012 holds the Atlas's initial values (near the 2012 census) and 2024 its final values (near the 2024 census). Each variable's actual reference years are given in its description and in geo:reference_years.

fields.name: mun_id
fields.title: INE municipality code
fields.description: Official municipality code of the National Statistics Institute (INE), DDPPMM (department, province, municipality) stored as an integer without the leading zero (e.g. 20101 = Nuestra Señora de La Paz), as in the Atlas. The Atlas's rows are linked to geo_id through this code.

fields.name: index_sdg7
fields.title: Affordable and clean energy index (0-100)
fields.description: SDG 7 (Affordable and clean energy) index of the Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026, on a 0-100 scale where 100 means the goal's targets are met and 0 the worst situation. Following the global SDG Index of SDSN, each of its 4 indicators is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between a worst and a best value (given in each indicator's description), with the direction set so that higher is always better and values beyond the bounds capped; the index is the simple mean of the available rescaled indicators. Components: Residential electricity consumption (kWh per person per year); Electricity coverage (% of population); Residential meters with zero consumption for 6+ months (%); Clean cooking energy (% of population). Initial value (~2012) stored at 2012 and final value (~2024) at 2024; its components refer to different years around each census. Atlas: “Índice ODS7”.
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: sdg7_1_cep
fields.title: Residential electricity consumption (kWh per person per year)
fields.description: Residential electricity consumption per person: total residential consumption divided by the population. Source: the residential electricity-meter database of the Ministry of Hydrocarbons and Energy for 2016 and 2024, compiled by Andersen et al. (2023). Initial value 2016 (stored at 2012) and final value 2024 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 7 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 0 (worst, 0) and 523 (best, 100), higher is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 500 and major challenges from 50 on. Atlas indicator 07_01_01_01_cep, “Consumo de electricidad residencial (kWh/persona/año)” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: sdg7_1_cae
fields.title: Electricity coverage (% of population)
fields.description: Percentage of the population in private dwellings with people present that has electricity. Source: INE tabulations of the INE Population and Housing Censuses of 2012 and 2024. Initial value 2012 (stored at 2012) and final value 2024 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 7 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 0 (worst, 0) and 100 (best, 100), higher is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 98 and major challenges from 80 on. Atlas indicator 07_01_01_02_cae, “Porcentaje de la población con cobertura de energía eléctrica” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: sdg7_1_mcc
fields.title: Residential meters with zero consumption for 6+ months (%)
fields.description: Percentage of residential electricity meters with zero consumption for six or more months of the year (dwellings connected to the grid without registered use). Source: the residential electricity-meter database of the Ministry of Hydrocarbons and Energy for 2016 and 2024, compiled by Andersen et al. (2023). Initial value 2016 (stored at 2012) and final value 2024 (stored at 2024). Missing for 14 of the 343 units in the initial period and 18 in the final one. In the SDG 7 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 69 (worst, 0) and 0 (best, 100), lower is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 4.5 and major challenges from 24.9 on. Atlas indicator 07_01_01_03_mcc, “Porcentaje de medidores eléctricos residenciales con consumo cero (6 meses o más)” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: sdg7_1_elc
fields.title: Clean cooking energy (% of population)
fields.description: Percentage of the population in private dwellings with people present that cooks with clean fuels. Source: INE tabulations of the INE Population and Housing Censuses of 2012 and 2024. Initial value 2012 (stored at 2012) and final value 2024 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 7 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 0 (worst, 0) and 100 (best, 100), higher is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 85 and major challenges from 50 on. Atlas indicator 07_01_02_04_elc, “Porcentaje de la población con energía limpia para cocinar” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
